rule: Zeitkorrektur of recorded time: midnight split, 24-hour limit, timeline, break warning, projection, pending sum

exempt.lib/time-corrections/actions.ts: Server Actions that authorize, call the database and revalidate; their time rules live in submission.ts and the covered modules it calls.
exempt.lib/time-corrections/approved-projection: Reads approved correction applications from the database; projection.ts applies them to recorded time.
exempt.lib/time-corrections/calendar-draft.ts: Maps a calendar drag to correction boundaries one to one and passes the times through; calendar-proposal.ts moves them.
exempt.lib/time-corrections/entry-source.ts: Maps a shown entry to the source and applied fact a correction names; no time arithmetic. merge-proposal.ts applies the correction to that fact's interval.
Which correction requests a role sees: a permission rule, no time or money.
Keeps the correction facts of a person's effective employee record: a permission filter, no time arithmetic; projection.ts applies the facts.
Reads the pending requests a caller may see: a visibility rule, no time arithmetic.
exempt.lib/time-corrections/planned-visit-reads: Server Action that reads a day's planned visits to prefill a timeline; it records no time.
exempt.lib/time-corrections/read-actions.ts: Server Action readers of corrections; the pending sum they return comes from provisional-summary.ts.
exempt.lib/time-corrections/request-list.ts: Reads and labels correction requests for the cards; their activities come from snapshot-segments.ts.
exempt.lib/time-corrections/source-context.ts: Reads a correction's source facts; a segment's facts come from segment-snapshot.ts.
exempt.lib/time-corrections/timeline-server.ts: Reads recorded time for the timeline check; timeline-validation.ts decides it.
exempt.lib/time-corrections/types.ts: Types, labels and the fact-to-entry mapping that projection.property.test.ts drives through applyApprovedTimeCorrections.
exempt.lib/time-corrections/validation.ts: Zod input schemas and the kind-to-fact-count shape check; it computes no time, timeline-validation.ts checks the proposed times.
